skill.name: sympy
skill.description: Use SymPy to solve symbolic mathematics problems in Python, including algebra, calculus, matrices, physics, statistics, and mathematical code generation.
skill.summary: Guides exact symbolic mathematics workflows with SymPy in Python.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown formatting, ordinary SymPy imports, symbolic constructors, dictionary keys, and documentation links. No prompt injection or exfiltration intent was found, but the code-generation guide contains unsafe examples for user-input parsing and pickle loading.

remediation.suggestion: Replace direct parse_expr(user_input) with validated input and constrained symbol maps. Place the security warning beside the example.

remediation.issue: Pickle loading lacks a trust-boundary warning
remediation.suggestion: State that pickle files must come from trusted local workflows only. Recommend text formats for shared or user-supplied data.

remediation.issue: Eval wording lacks a safety caveat
remediation.suggestion: Avoid recommending eval for expression reconstruction. If mentioned, state never to eval untrusted strings.

content.value_statement: Symbolic math work often needs exact algebra, calculus, and matrix results across many SymPy APIs. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical SymPy workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guide creation of symbols, assumptions, expressions, and exact arithmetic.
Show algebraic solving, simplification, expansion, factoring, and verification workflows.
Explain derivatives, integrals, limits, series, and differential equation solving.
Support symbolic matrix operations, eigenvalues, linear systems, and basis changes.
Cover physics, units, statistics, geometry, number theory, and special functions.
Generate LaTeX, strings, and language-specific code from SymPy expressions.
limitations: It does not install SymPy or manage Python environments.
Some equations have no closed-form symbolic solution.
Generated code and parsed input need security review before production use.
Large symbolic expressions can become slow or difficult to simplify.

use_cases.title: Solve Coursework Problems
use_cases.description: Work through exact algebra, calculus, and matrix problems with stepwise SymPy methods.

use_cases.title: Prototype Scientific Models
use_cases.description: Derive formulas, simplify equations, and convert expressions into numerical functions.

use_cases.title: Generate Math Output
use_cases.description: Convert symbolic results into LaTeX, readable text, or generated source code.

prompt_templates.title: Solve an Equation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use SymPy to solve this equation exactly. Show the symbols, solver choice, result, and verification steps: [equation].

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Calculus Expression
prompt_templates.prompt: Use SymPy to differentiate, integrate, and simplify this expression. Explain any assumptions needed: [expression].

prompt_templates.title: Model a Matrix Problem
prompt_templates.prompt: Use SymPy to solve this matrix problem. Include determinant, inverse or rank checks, eigenvalues, and exact results: [matrix problem].

prompt_templates.title: Create Production-Ready Math Code
prompt_templates.prompt: Use SymPy to derive the formula, optimize it, and outline safe code generation steps for this target language: [requirements].

output_examples.input: Solve x squared minus five x plus six equals zero.
output_examples.output: The skill would define x as a symbol, solve the polynomial, and verify the exact roots 2 and 3.

output_examples.input: Find the derivative and integral of sin(x squared).
output_examples.output: The skill would return the exact derivative, explain the integral form, and note when a special function appears.

output_examples.input: Convert a symbolic distance formula into C output.
output_examples.output: The skill would derive the expression, generate C-oriented output, and recommend tests for edge cases and numeric precision.

best_practices: Define symbols and assumptions before building expressions.
Use exact numbers such as Rational for symbolic work.
Validate parsed input and test generated code before reuse.
anti_patterns: Do not use floating-point constants when exact results matter.
Do not parse untrusted user input without strict validation.
Do not rely on simplify alone for every transformation.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps AI tools use SymPy for exact symbolic mathematics in Python.

faq.question: Does it replace numerical libraries?
faq.answer: No. It complements NumPy, SciPy, and mpmath when exact formulas or derivations are needed.

faq.question: Can it generate executable code?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers SymPy code generation and printing, but generated code still needs review and tests.

faq.question: Can it solve every equation?
faq.answer: No. Some equations require numerical methods or cannot be solved in closed form.

faq.question: Is parsing user input safe?
faq.answer: Only with strict validation and constrained symbols. Untrusted input should not be passed directly to parsers.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
